paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, image borders, nav backgrounds — the only surface tone in the system

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, all border outlines on images and nav, list markers — the sole chromatic anchor

title.$description: Display serif used exclusively for the brand title and hero headlines. The custom serif — with its high contrast strokes and slightly condensed forms — carries all brand identity. Letter-spacing of -0.018em tightens the large caps just enough to feel deliberate without becoming stiff. A close substitute would be a transitional or didone-style serif like 'GT Sectra Display' or free options 'Playfair Display' / 'DM Serif Display'

neue-haas-grotesk-display.$description: All UI, navigation, captions, metadata, and body-adjacent text. Geometric grotesque at a single weight (400) — the system deliberately avoids bold/light contrast, using size and placement to create hierarchy instead. Use 'Inter' or 'Neue Haas Grotesk' itself (free via Adobe) as substitutes
